## Preset

Name of the preset:

## Type

- Particle system preset
- Scene preset
- Combined scene and particle preset

## Demonstrated Features

Which modules, emitters, renderers, lighting, collision, LOD, or benchmark
behaviors does this show?

## GUI Controls

What controls were added, and what should users tweak?

## Screenshot

Add a screenshot, video, or animated GIF showing the preset.

## Assets And Attribution

List assets, examples, references, and author credit.

## Verification

- [ ] Preset loads in the demo
- [ ] Switching away from the preset cleans up resources
- [ ] Source and author metadata are present
- [ ] `npm run build --workspace apps/demo`


### Example / Preset Changes

Applies when adding or substantially changing particle examples.

- [ ] Implementation is canonical in `examples/` and works in the demo.
- [ ] Metadata and documentation source regions are complete and valid.
- [ ] The example guide was generated or updated.
- [ ] System, emitter, module, and renderer choices and important values are explained.
- [ ] Visual previews were inspected where applicable, with backend results reported.
- [ ] `npm run docs:generate` and `npm run docs:check` pass; generated artifacts are included.
